text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
A bet~? Jeez, whatever, just hurry up and 
take your present already.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Someone who loves events handing over a 
present so awkwardly... There's gotta be a 
story behind it. Let me guess.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If I miss, I'll get you an amazing present 
for your birthday.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! You're giving me something that 
nice!? Sweet, sweet, try and guess!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Most likely, she pulled a prank with the 
present. She probably planted a gag item 
to try and surprise me, but—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You started feeling guilty on your way 
here, didn't you? Something like that? 
Ain't that adorable.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Too bad, you're wrooong! You totally 
missed the mark. Pffft.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hah? Then what was the right answer, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I got super serious picking it out. 
Spent quite a bit of time on it. Then when 
it was time to hand it over... it felt way 
too serious, which was kinda embarrassing! 
Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Y-You'd better get me something good, 
got it? It's my birthday, after all."
